situation: Two suppliers under a fragile cartel — when both hold price the market stays fat and lucrative, but a single price war flips everyone into a lean commodity game that is hard to climb back out of

players.name: Acme
players.note: Holds price if the other does, but tempted while margins are fat

players.name: Borex
players.note: Conditional cooperator, slow to forgive a price war

rationale.R: both hold price = steady shared margin
rationale.T: undercut once while they hold = grab share
rationale.S: hold while they undercut = lose share
rationale.w: the market lasts many quarters unless it consolidates
rationale.noise: a promo misread as a price war
rationale.transitions: fat = the lucrative market both want to protect; lean = the commodity game a price war drops everyone into; CC keeps it fat, any defection tips it lean
